perturbed_solution:
The equation implies that either \[
x-1 = 2-x\]or \[ x-1 = -(x-2).\]The first equation has solution $x=-1$; the second equation has solution $x= \boxed{\frac{3}{4}}$.

errors.rationale: Solving x-1=-(x-2) gives x=3/2, so changing the denominator from 2 to 4 while keeping the numerator 3 is incorrect.
The first branch from |x-1|=|x-2| should be x-1=x-2, not x-1=2-x; this duplicates the second branch instead of keeping the positive case.

errors.original_text: The first equation has no solution
errors.rationale: The equation x-1=x-2 gives -1=-2, so it has no solution; stating x=-1 is a sign-handling mistake.
